output.title: Vault issuer config feature applicability undetermined
output.content: The change adds a server-name configuration option to the Vault issuer. The environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with Certificate resources, but the CRDs dimension is absent, so it cannot be confirmed whether Vault issuers are installed or configured. Check your cluster for issuers.cert-manager.io or clusterissuers.cert-manager.io resources with vault: stanzas, and review the Vault issuer documentation in the v1.18.0 release notes if you use Vault-backed certificate issuance.
